# gg

> Pure Go 2D graphics library: immediate-mode drawing (paths, shapes, strokes, gradients, images, text) on a CPU
> rasterizer core, with optional GPU acceleration through gogpu/wgpu (in a gogpu app: the backend gogpu picks, e.g.
> Vulkan, DX12, Metal, GLES; standalone: Vulkan for now). The API
> has two styles over one context: stateful (`SetColor`, `Fill`) and per-call paint. Also: a retained scene graph,
> 29 blend modes, layers and alpha masks, a Pure Go font stack (TrueType and CFF, variable fonts, OpenType shaping,
> hinting, MSDF and glyph-mask GPU text), an SVG renderer, and a recording system for PDF/SVG export. CPU rendering
> needs no GPU; `import _ "github.com/gogpu/gg/gpu"` turns on the GPU accelerator. Go 1.25+, zero CGO. Pre-1.0: the
> API may change before v1.0.

## Docs

- [API Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg): package documentation
- [README](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, quick start
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents using gg
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): CPU core, GPU accelerator tiers, text and scene pipelines
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [ROADMAP](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): plans toward v1.0
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Packages

- [gg](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg): drawing context, paths, paint, pixmaps
- [gg/text](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg/text): fonts, shaping, layout
- [gg/scene](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg/scene): retained-mode scene graph
- [gg/svg](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg/svg): SVG parsing and rendering
- [gg/recording](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg/recording): command recording for vector export
- [gg/gpu](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg/gpu): opt-in GPU accelerator registration
- [gg/integration/ggcanvas](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg/integration/ggcanvas): drawing into a gogpu window

## Examples

- [examples](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/tree/main/examples): all examples
- [basic](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/tree/main/examples/basic): shapes on the CPU, saved to PNG
- [text](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/tree/main/examples/text): font loading and text rendering
- [gogpu_integration](https://github.com/gogpu/gg/tree/main/examples/gogpu_integration): GPU-accelerated drawing in a gogpu window

## Related

- [gg-pdf](https://github.com/gogpu/gg-pdf): PDF export backend for gg/recording
- [gg-svg](https://github.com/gogpu/gg-svg): SVG export backend for gg/recording

## Ecosystem

- [GoGPU ecosystem](https://gogpu.dev/llms.txt): map of all modules
- [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/gogpu): support development
